card.name: Hypo- medical terms like hypoparathyroidism
card.fires_on: Responds to the 'hyp' or 'op' pieces inside words like hypoparathyroidism, hypopituitarism, hypoplasia and hypertrophy. Also fires on 'present' after 'which may' and on a few linking words like 'the' or 'with'.

modes.label: Inside hypo-/hyper- words
modes.description: The start of a long endocrine or blood term beginning with hyp-, split before the rest of the word.

modes.label: Verb 'present' in infection text
modes.description: The word 'present' after 'which may' when describing how tuberculosis shows up.
modes.example: Active tuberculosis, which may<< present>> with pulmonary or extrapulmonary disease

modes.label: Linking words before a clinical term
modes.description: A small word such as 'the' or 'with' just before a condition or body-function noun.

card.writes: Weakly suggests word pieces like 'front' or 'Lar'; mostly no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up partway through words like hypoparathyroidism and on 'present' in 'may present with'.
